gmcm.enableMod.tooltip: Master switch. When off, every mouse action is left to the vanilla game.
gmcm.chest.sameType.enabled.tooltip: Drag with the plain left button over chest slots to move stacks matching the first item.
gmcm.chest.allItems.enabled.tooltip: Drag with the configured modifiers to move every stack passed over.
gmcm.chest.takeAll.enabled.tooltip: A single click moves every matching stack from the clicked side to the other side.
gmcm.wheel.enable.tooltip: Scroll down to send the hovered stack to the other side; scroll up to pull matching items to it.
gmcm.wheel.small.amount.tooltip: Items per notch with the small-step modifiers.
gmcm.wheel.medium.amount.tooltip: Items per notch with the medium-step modifiers.
gmcm.wheel.large.amount.tooltip: Items per notch with the large-step modifiers.
gmcm.wheel.reverse.tooltip: Swap the send and pull directions.
gmcm.wheel.oppositeInventory.tooltip: In the chest menu, reverse the scroll direction only when hovering the player inventory side. The chest side keeps the normal direction.
gmcm.inventory.divide.enabled.tooltip: Hold divided items over inventory slots, drag over valid slots, and release to distribute the held stack.
gmcm.inventory.distribute.enabled.toolti: Drag with the right button to place one item into each valid slot passed over.
gmcm.inventory.collect.enabled.tooltip: After picking up a stack, double-click the same slot within 0.25s to pull matching stacks into the held stack.
gmcm.reserve.mode.tooltip: Global uses one switch for all chests; Per chest stores a switch in each chest for this player.
gmcm.reserve.globalEnabled.tooltip: Used in Global mode. Per-chest mode reads the tray button inside each chest.
gmcm.reserve.amount.tooltip: Keep at least this many of each eligible item group in the chest when this mod takes items out.
gmcm.reserve.onlyStackable.tooltip: On by default. Uses the item's current stacking rules, including changes by stacking mods. Turn off to also apply the categories below.
gmcm.reserve.categories.tooltip: Only used when 'Reserve only stackable items' is off. All categories default off. Matching saved properties share N without merging items; different upgrades, enchantments or trinket seeds stay separate. Unknown types use Other. Items whose saved state cannot be compared are counted separately.
gmcm.reserve.leftClick: Reserve also limits vanilla left click
gmcm.reserve.leftClick.tooltip: When reserve is on, a plain left click on a chest stack cannot take the last N. Drag gestures are always limited.
gmcm.reserve.rightClick: Reserve also limits vanilla right click
gmcm.reserve.rightClick.tooltip: When reserve is on, a plain right click on a chest stack keeps at least N of that type.
gmcm.reserve.shiftRightClick: Reserve also limits vanilla Shift+right click
gmcm.reserve.shiftRightClick.tooltip: When reserve is on, a Shift+right click half-stack split keeps at least N of that type. Ctrl+Shift+right click is left to Convenient Inventory.
gmcm.modifiers.tooltip: Keys held together with the mouse button, separated by + (for example Shift or Ctrl+Shift). Leave empty for no modifier.
gmcm.duplicate.chest: Duplicate chest binding: {{actions}}. The most specific binding is used, in a fixed order.
gmcm.duplicate.wheel: Duplicate wheel binding: {{actions}}. The largest matching step is used, in a fixed order.
